author: bardic-inspiration
name: Truthful Candle
summary: A candle that compels honest answers while it burns.
description: White tallow stamped with a thumbprint. Magistrates in the old cities swear by them in hearings.

stats.effect: You can light this candle as a Magic action. For up to 10 minutes while it burns, any creature within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw each time it tries to knowingly speak a lie, or it cannot speak the lie. The candle is consumed as it burns.
